extra.message: User-controlled `search_term` from the JSON body of POST /search is interpolated directly into a raw SQL string via '%' formatting and executed with db.engine.execute(). extra.message: The attacker-controlled `request.url` (404 handler fires on any nonexistent path, so the URL/query string is fully attacker chosen) is embedded via '%' string formatting directly into the template SOURCE STRING before being passed to render_template_string(). Because it becomes part of the template text rather than a context variable, Jinja2 syntax in the URL (e.g. {{7*7}} or {{ self.__init__.__globals__ }}) is evaluated server-side, enabling Server-Side Template Injection and potential remote code execution. The handler additionally injects `dir`, `help`, and `locals` builtins into the template context, which further aids introspection/exploitation from within the template sandbox.
